stock.description: China Ting Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures, sells, trades, exports, and retails garments and branded fashion apparels in Mainland China, North America, European Union, Hong Kong, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Manufacturing and Sales of Garments on an Original Equipment Manufacturer Basis; Manufacturing and Retailing of Branded Fashion Apparel; and Property Investment in Chinese Mainland. The company is also involved in the manufacture of wool textiles and knitwear; printing and dyeing silk and other fabrics; weaving of silk fabric and spun silk fabric; and property investment and holding activities. It retails its products under the FINITY, ELANIE RIESE, RIVERSTONE, Trenta, Volcom, VILEBREQUIN, SPRAYGROUND, and JOTT brands through e-commerce, self-operated store, and franchisees. China Ting Group Holdings Limited was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong. China Ting Group Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Longerview Investments Limited.
